description: Source code implementing CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) algorithms, including functions for CRC calculation, table initialization, and CRC manipulation, specifically for abseil's internal CRC implementation.

classes.name: CRC
classes.description: Base class for CRC algorithms, providing interface for CRC operations and singleton access for CRC32C.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Implementation of CRC-32 algorithm with table initialization, extension, unextension, scrambling, and un scrambling methods.

methods.name: CRC::Crc32c
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of CRC for CRC32C polynomial.

methods.name: CRC::Concat
methods.description: Concatenates CRCs of two messages based on polynomial mathematics.

methods.name: CRC32::InitTables
methods.description: Initializes CRC tables for fast CRC computation.

methods.name: CRC32::Extend
methods.description: Extends CRC value with additional data bytes.

methods.name: CRC32::ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends CRC value by a specified number of zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Reverses the extension of CRC by zero bits.

methods.name: CRC32::Scramble
methods.description: Scrambles CRC value for internal use.

methods.name: CRC32::Unscramble
methods.description: Unscrambles CRC value to original form.

methods.name: CRCImpl::NewInternal
methods.description: Creates a new CRC implementation, attempting to use accelerated methods if available.

methods.name: CRCImpl::Empty
methods.description: Sets CRC to the polynomial value for an empty string.
